name: Arphaxad
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Shem are named: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram, and the sons that came after them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The chosen line is set down plainly: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, who is Abraham.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom
